title: Compilation into a finite Turing machine
statement: Let $P$ be a register program with $m$ registers and $d$ deciders, and let $D$ be a decider with $k_D$ work tapes. Given an initial program state and a choice of initial state for each decider, define the compiled finite Boolean Turing machine by compiling these data into a machine with $m+k_D$ work tapes.
